title: Source-free proof review: unknown homophone weights, profile likelihood and conditioning on the output bag

contract.bank: One fixed finite bank B of distinct nonempty output words. A candidate key K supplies a deterministic surjective decoder D_K:B->{0,...,m-1}; m=27in the full declared channel, but the proofs hold for any finite m.
contract.source: An independently fixed normalized source law P_source on complete sequences of the specified length N and declared boundary/reset convention. It may be IID or non-IID. The bank and source law are not reselected from favorable key outcomes.
contract.emissions: One unknown positive weight q(w)per bank word. Given source value c, independently emit w in B_c with probability q(w)/Z_K(c), where Z_K(c)=sum_{v in B_c}q(v). The weights are unrestricted positive nuisance parameters, not a known frozen q and not a lower-dimensional shape model.
contract.observed_statistics: For an ordered observed output w_1,...,w_N, let n_w be each word count, c_i=D_K(w_i), and n_c=sum_{D_K(w)=c}n_w. No actual data counts enter this note.

profile_derivation.emission_reparameterization: For fixed K, any collection of positive normalized within-class emissions e_c(w)can be realized by q(w)=a_c*e_c(w)with arbitrary positive a_c. Thus profiling q is exactly independent multinomial profiling within each decoded class.
profile_derivation.interior_solution: If every bank word is observed, n_w>0, then e_hat(w)=n_w/n_c is an interior maximum. Its exact ordered-sequence log likelihood is logP_source(c_1,...,c_N)+sum_w n_w*log(n_w/n_{D_K(w)}). No multinomial factor belongs in this likelihood for one ordered output sequence.
profile_derivation.parameters: The identifiable emission dimension is sum_c(|B_c|-1)=|B|-m. If q is normalized globally, its |B|-1dimensions include m-1unidentified class-mass scales. If q is unnormalized, mpositive class scales are unidentified. Different bodies/classes are not assumed to share equal emission weights.
profile_derivation.one_common_q_model: Estimating a different nuisance maximizer for each candidate K is ordinary profiling of the same globally parameterized unknown-q family. It does not justify fitting weights that the original experiment declared known and fixed. It also does not permit choosing a new bank or source prior per key.

iid_identity.assumption: The normalized source law is IID with known pi_c>0. Let f_K(c)=n_c/N.
iid_identity.consequence: The first term is independent of K, but the second generally is not. Uniform IID pi favors higher decoded empirical entropy in the profile score; it is not generally pooling-flat. Source-label symmetries of the fixed law remain possible.
iid_identity.pooling_limit: If pi is also separately fitted as f_K, the KL term vanishes for every key and the familiar empirical IID pooling identity returns. This is a changed source-prior contract. Equal single-character marginals alone do not remove non-IID ordering information.

support_and_attainment: Use0log0=0and omit zero-count word terms. An unobserved decoded class contributes no emission log term and leaves its emission distribution unestimated.

If an observed class contains an unobserved bank word, its multinomial optimum assigns that word weight0. Under strictly positive q the displayed empirical expression is then ordinarily a SUPREMUM approached at the boundary, not an attained maximum. Classes wholly unobserved may retain any positive emissions. Observing every bank word is sufficient, but not necessary, for attainment.

A positivity floor, pseudocount, prior or finite-dimensional weight law changes the optimization. Under a constrained shape/length model for q, the free-emission expression is only an upper bound unless that model attains all relevant class distributions.

Bank coverage/surjectivity is a condition on the full fixed bank, not just the observed vocabulary. Dropping unseen bank words or renormalizing the source law to visited classes changes the declared model.

The all-bank-words-observed assumption concerns the realized sample for this algebra. A design that filters samples by coverage or other events needs its own sampling/conditioning account; it is not supplied by silently redefining the bank.
If the source law assigns probability0to the decoded sequence, the joint likelihood is0. A source histogram of probability0cannot be rescued through undefined conditional0/0.

bag_conditioning.distinct_output_orders: Fix the complete output bag n=(n_w). The emission factor product_w e_K(w)^n_w is identical for every distinct output ordering in that bag and cancels from its conditional distribution.
bag_conditioning.multiplicity: For any source sequence with histogram(n_c), exactly A_K(n)=product_c(n_c!)/product_w(n_w!)distinct output sequences with bag n decode to it. This number does not depend on source order but generally depends on K.
bag_conditioning.conditional_likelihood: P_K(w_1,...,w_N | n)=P_source(c_1,...,c_N)/[A_K(n)*P_source(Histogram=(n_c))], when the denominator is positive.
bag_conditioning.iid_limit: For every fixed IID pi with positive probability for the bag, this simplifies to product_w(n_w!)/N!: uniform over the distinct output orderings, independent of K and pi. Therefore bag-conditioned inference deliberately loses the IID frequency information that remains in the unconditional profile likelihood.
bag_conditioning.markov_limit: A fixed Markov or other non-IID source law may retain ordering information, but its key-dependent histogram probability and the combinatorial factor must still be included. A raw language score is not the normalized cross-key conditional likelihood. Within a fixed key, or among keys with exactly the same relevant histogram and normalizer, those factors can be constant; this does not extend automatically to all keys.
bag_conditioning.computational_limit: The exact source-histogram probability may be expensive to compute at large alphabet/length. No full-scale dynamic program, approximation, decoder or native key search is licensed by the identity.

scope_and_prior_distinctions: GDT1322REPORT uses fixed bank AND fixed q. Its class-mass correction and ranking counterexample remain correct. Unknown-q profiling is a separately declared nuisance model, not a correction to that experiment.

GDT1324REPORT evaluates exact recovery with known fixed spelling weights and two fixed source laws. Its8-key toy probabilities, symmetry limits and prior-dependent recovery results are not recomputed or superseded here. Giving the scorer less apparatus knowledge cannot erase an existing indistinguishability example.

The profile maximum is an in-sample score, not a normalized predictive law obtained by treating its data-dependent fitted probabilities as externally known. Sparse-support held-out prediction needs a prospectively fixed smoothing/prior method; the unsmoothed supremum gives new bank words probability0.

A fixed independent source prior, bank/segmentation/sampling contract, and large discrete key search remain substantive commitments. The |B|-m free emissions also do not explain directed word construction; shapes are still bank apparatus. No mathematical formula here demonstrates native feasibility or recovery.

Bounded registry/route-check searches and exact1322/1324primaries did not supply an executed unknown-q profiling counterpart. This is a scoped retrieval observation, not a historical novelty theorem or a claim that profile likelihood is new statistics.
